known_issues: Rate card upload is blocked due to admin-rights restrictions.

existing_features.title: Ensure the frontend rate card upload flow works end-to-end for non-admin users by handling any remaining authorization errors with clear English messages and confirming the UI refreshes to show the updated rate card after a successful upload.

new_feature_requests.summary: Remove admin-right restrictions so the user can upload the rate card (remove all restrictions)
Remove admin-only authorization checks that prevent non-admin users from uploading/updating the rate card; any authenticated user must be able to update the master rate card data.
Remove admin-only authorization checks for rate-card maintenance operations so they are not restricted by admin role (addRateCardItem, updateRateCardItem, deleteRateCardItem, updateStandardCost).
Remove admin-only authorization checks for account manager maintenance so they are not restricted by admin role (updateAccountManagers, addAccountManager, updateAccountManager, deleteAccountManager).
